messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: Dedicated pool 'horizon-dedicated-eu' reported GPU node failure node-gpu-42. Severity: HIGH. Potential customer impact: HorizonTech (VPC tenant) - inference errors / OOMs seen. Paging @arjun_oncall. Logs + first-alert attached.

arjun_oncall: On it. Confirming root: saw kernel oops + ECC on PCIe reported in node logs. Marking node as draining. Will assess customer impact in thread. @marie_sre fyi.

marie_sre: Thanks. Any automated fallback already triggered? Ops-bot, has traffic been routed away from the pool?

ops-bot: AUTOACTION: Routing policy applied -> traffic rebalanced away from node-gpu-42 across 'horizon-dedicated-eu' shards. Canary fallback to alternate pool 'shared-eu-lowcost' if necessary. No failover triggered yet.

arjun_oncall: Starting cordon + drain now. Commands:

```
kubectl cordon node-gpu-42
kubectl drain node-gpu-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=10m
```

Will watch KV cache hot keys for model serving (horizon-chat-3b). If caches can't migrate, we'll fail requests to hosted fallback with 503 and notify HorizonTech.

devon_rt: If drain stalls because of long KV restore, we can force migrate by snapshotting the KV and warming on another shard. I have a small script to expedite. Pasting snippet:

```
# copy kv cache
rclone copy /mnt/kv/node-gpu-42 gs://temp-kv/node-gpu-42-snap
# trigger warm on target
curl -X POST https://rt-control/api/warm?pool=horizon-dedicated-eu-target\&model=horizon-chat-3b
```

Use with caution — will add traffic pressure.

sanjay_infra: Hardware side: BMC shows ECC errors and a DIMM flagged. I'm opening a hardware ticket with our cloud partner to replace the physical host if it's not a transient PCIe error. ETA for replacement depends on supplier (1-4 hours for dedicated racks). If node is spot-backed, we may see full preemption. I'm checking lease type now.

nora_cs: I'm drafting a customer note for HorizonTech. Initial statement: "We're investigating intermittent inference failures for your VPC-dedicated pool. We're draining the affected host and routing traffic; you may see elevated latencies or errors. We'll provide updates and expected ETA for a replacement." Any ops notes to add?

horizontech-ops: We see elevated 5xx on our end around 12:07 UTC, ~4% of requests. Appreciate updates. Do you have an ETA? Can you confirm any data plane exposure?

arjun_oncall: No data plane exposure. Requests that hit the failing node returned errors; most traffic was rebalanced. ETA depends on whether this is a replace vs reboot; I'll confirm after hardware ticket. For now, expected initial mitigation (drain + route) done, so errors should trend down. Monitoring.

devon_rt: Observing increased tail latency on horizon-chat-3b due to KV warming on new shards. Dropping batch size for that model to reduce OOM risk: enabling runtime override:

```
model-config set horizon-chat-3b --max-batch 4 --quantization-profile reduced-latency
```

That should shave median latency down while background warm proceeds.

marie_sre: Log snippets (truncated):

```
[2026-07-11T12:06:59Z] node-gpu-42: gpu0: ECC corrected errors threshold exceeded
[2026-07-11T12:07:10Z] kernel: pcie: AER: PCIe AER: uncorr_error severity=Corrected
[2026-07-11T12:07:12Z] runtime: eviction: model horizon-chat-3b OOM on gpu0
```

This looks like hardware-induced memory corruption, not just driver. Recommend replace host.

sanjay_infra: Confirmed host is not spot — it's reserved node in HorizonTech's dedicated pool. I'll escalate with datacenter ops for DIMM replacement. Since this is a customer-dedicated reserved node, replacement SLA is prioritized. ETA update in 30 minutes.

nora_cs: Noted. I'll send a targeted message to HorizonTech ops channel with what we've said here and the current mitigation steps. Want to be transparent that we're prioritizing replacement under their Dedicated contract.

horizontech-ops: Thanks. Also want confirmation that model versions won't drift during warm. We need identical model weights and KV continuity.

devon_rt: KV snapshot + warm maintains weights; runtime uses consistent model-pin. I'll verify the model checksum on the target shard. Command I ran:

```
sha256sum /models/horizon-chat-3b/checkpoint.pt
```

Match confirmed.

arjun_oncall: Quick checklist for this incident:
- [x] Cordon + drain node-gpu-42
- [x] Rebalance routing away from node
- [x] Notify customer (nora_cs sent initial)
- [x] Lower batch for horizon-chat-3b (devon_rt)
- [ ] Hardware replacement (sanjay_infra) - in progress
- [ ] Post-replace soak & KV integrity check (devon_rt)
- [ ] Close incident and follow-up RCA (marie_sre)

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: error rate dropped from 4% -> 1.1% in last 10m after draining. Will continue to monitor. If error rate holds >1% for 15m, escalate to SEV1 and page leadership.

marie_sre: Planning handoff at +45m if still open. @arjun_oncall can you confirm if you want to hand off to @marie_sre or stay on for the swap?

arjun_oncall: I'll stay through replacement commit; happy to hand off once replacement started and soak thresholds are green.

sanjay_infra: Hardware ticket created: TICKET-4521 to vendor. Assigned on-site engineer. Replacement ETA 1h30m. I'll post updates.

nora_cs: Update sent to HorizonTech: "We've drained the affected host and rebalanced traffic. Error rate improving. Replacement ETA ~1.5h under your Dedicated SLA. We'll notify when replacement complete and perform KV integrity checks." They replied: "Thanks, please prioritize. No PII exposure." Copying.

horizontech-ops: Appreciate the transparency. We'll prepare for post-replace validation window on our side.

devon_rt: After replacement, plan:
1) validate node health and model checksums
2) run KV integrity compare
3) join controlled reintroduce to pool (cordon off -> warm -> uncordon)

I'll prepare the reintroduce script and share here.

marie_sre: Noted. I'll own the RCA & timeline post-incident. Please paste the final error trend and ticket links in the thread before closing.

ops-bot: MONITOR: error_rate(tenant=horizontech) = 1.0% (5m avg). latency_p50 = 128ms, p95 = 1.4s. Alert thresholds not breached.

arjun_oncall: Thanks team. Leaving watcher on console. Will post final when replacement begins. If anyone needs to escalate to leadership or Legal for a customer notice, ping me.

sanjay_infra: Update: on-site confirmed DIMM failure, engineer started replacement. ETA now ~50m. Rolling status here.

horizontech-ops: OK thanks. We'll stand by.

marie_sre: Handoff note for whoever follows: watch for KV mismatch alerts and model-serving latency spikes during reintroduce. If >2% errors on reintroduce, revert and re-run warm with lower concurrency.

arjun_oncall: Handoff planned at 1803006820. After that @marie_sre will take lead. Closing on-call for this pager but staying reachable. /me sets final status to 'mitigated - replacement in progress'.

incident-bot: INCIDENT LOGGED: incident_id=INC-20260711-3092. Status: MITIGATED -> REPLACEMENT_IN_PROGRESS. All updates will be attached to ticket.
